showInactiveHint: Include reasons that are turned off.
empty: No reasons in this category yet.
footerHint: System reasons cannot be turned off.
limitHint: You can add up to 500 reasons.

hints.kind: Reason catalogue category selected from the active tab; fixed after opening so the reason belongs to this list.
hints.code: 2 to 64 characters: starts with A–Z, then A–Z, 0–9 or _. Used in reports and APIs and cannot be changed later.
hints.nameAr: Required Arabic display name (up to 120 characters) shown to users when the interface language is Arabic.
hints.nameEn: Required English display name (up to 120 characters) shown to users when the interface language is English.
hints.polarity: Classifies the outcome as positive, neutral or negative for activity analytics; cannot be changed after creation.
hints.activityType: Limits this outcome to one activity type or makes it available for all types; cannot be changed after creation.
hints.definitionAr: Optional Arabic explanation (up to 500 characters) helping sales reps choose the right reason consistently.
hints.definitionEn: Optional English explanation (up to 500 characters) helping sales reps choose the right reason consistently.
hints.sortOrder: Whole number from 0 to 1,000,000 controlling the position of this reason in dropdowns and tables (lower appears first).
hints.active: Controls whether this reason can be selected on new records.

conflict.title: Reason changed
conflict.text: Someone changed this reason. Reload to see the latest version, or keep your changes to save them.

discard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discard.text: Your changes have not been saved yet.

validation.range: Must be a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
validation.reasonCode: Start with A–Z and use only A–Z, 0–9 or _ (2 to 64 characters).
